title: Fix Provider/model mismatch in GetConfiguration and 503 error paths
description:
Fix provider/model mismatch in GetConfiguration and 503 error paths (Council-refined)

Source: audits/swarm-audit-synthesis-26-07-26.md

Problem: Controller/service GetConfiguration paths may map provider strings inconsistently, producing 503s or saving the wrong provider string to DB. Fix normalization surface, add validation and guard rails.

Acceptance criteria:
- NormalizeProvider is centralized and covered by unit tests for OpenAI/Ollama/Others
- End-to-end path for saving provider verifies runtime provider is available before persisting
- 503 paths log the underlying reason with actionable remediation steps

Effort: 4-8h

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Audit synthesis distinction: provider/model mismatch handling is already tracked here. The redacted audit also identifies a separate authorization gap when callers supply model/provider overrides; that capability decision is being tracked independently so configuration correctness and caller authorization remain testable.
